chunks: About purchasing goods obtained through embezzlement and theft, he said: “If you know that it is so, then no, unless it is something you are buying from the authorities.”

key_terms.الْخِيَانَةِ: betrayal or embezzlement involving misappropriated property
key_terms.عَرَفْتَ: you know with awareness or certainty

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy goods that are known to be stolen or taken through betrayal?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on purchasing property known to be acquired through betrayal or theft. It prohibits such a purchase when its unlawful origin is known, while mentioning an exception concerning goods bought from the authorities.
